text:
Maria (CS): FYI customer AcmeCorp says their 03/31 invoice (INV-20240331-ACME) is ~1.2M tokens but dashboard totals 920k. They escalated, saying promised credits should have reduced it. Can we audit? :eyes:
Alex (Billing): Thanks. Do we have the invoice PDF and a dashboard snapshot? Any plan change or migrations mid-month?
Maria (CS): They upgraded to Pro on 2024-03-20. Screenshot and invoice attached in ticket (not included here). Also support ticket has note about a bulk embeddings job at 03/31 23:50 UTC that looked big.
Jordan (SRE): I can pull metering logs. Need example request ids from the customer and their timezone. Cutoff is UTC midnight for invoices right?
Maria (CS): Customer timezone US/Pacific. Example request id from their ticket: req_0a1b2c3d. They mentioned a migration tool that retried many embedding calls around 23:50 UTC.
Alex (Billing): If a backfill or migration retried without idempotency keys we can double count. Our billing dedup window is small; bulk splits can look like unique calls. SRE — can you check ingestion and ledger write times?
Jordan (SRE): Quick look in ingestion: found job_987 starting 2024-03-31T23:50:12Z. It split into ~1.2k child requests within 2 minutes. Some child requests missing idempotency-key. I can see ~280k tokens attributed to that batch. Also found a shard-merge edgecase that delayed events and then wrote them right before finalization.
Lilly (Finance): We had a deferred-credit process for migration errors. However the credits were applied to the ledger on 2024-04-02, after the 03/31 invoice was finalized. If customer expected pre-close application, timing mismatch is the root.
Maria (CS): Customer insists credits were promised pre-close. They want corrected invoice if possible. How exactly does dashboard vs invoice differ?
Alex (Billing): Dashboard shows near-real-time aggregate in customer tz and excludes some pending/deferred adjustments. Invoice reflects the snapshot of the finalized ledger at cutoff (UTC 00:00) plus any posts that were committed before finalization. Mid-month tier changes can also affect which slab tokens get bucketed into during invoice computation.
Jordan (SRE): Repro query I ran:
```
SELECT sum(tokens) FROM metering.events
WHERE account = 'acme' AND ts >= '2024-03-01' AND ts < '2024-04-01'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC');
```
Results match dashboard for most days. On 2024-03-31 there is an extra ~280k tokens coming from events with ingest_delay > 300s that ended up written before ledger snapshot. Some of those are duplicates (missing idempotency + identical payload checksum).
Alex (Billing): Action list: 1) SRE flag probable duplicates and prepare auto-credit; 2) Billing ops check whether credits can be applied retroactively or if we need to reissue invoice/credit memo; 3) CS communicate timeline and options to customer.
Jordan (SRE): I flagged ~45k tokens as high-confidence duplicates and opened BILL-4456 to queue auto-credit. Also traced a shard bug (ingest_shard_7) that caused 2x counting for late batches — patch in staging now.
Lilly (Finance): If difference is material (>5%) we usually reissue corrected invoice. This is ~28% delta so reissue preferred unless customer explicitly wants a credit memo. Need approval from Legal/Procurement for reissue process.
Maria (CS): Customer procurement prefers a corrected invoice. I'll offer both but say reissue is favored.
Alex (Billing): Noted. Please add ticket links and sample IDs to BILL-4456. We'll draft a credit memo meanwhile.
Maria (CS): Adding links: support TKT-991, SRE JOB-987, billing BILL-4456. Updating customer now. Thanks team :pray:
billing-bot: Invoice INV-20240331-ACME marked for review; pending credit memo draft. Assigned to Alex (Billing).
Jordan (SRE): I'll push the shard-merge fix in the next deploy window and follow up with a verification log dump once rolled.
Lilly (Finance): Once credit memo or corrected invoice is approved I'll update the ledger and send procurement docs to the customer.
Maria (CS): I'll close the loop with AcmeCorp and ask which they prefer (credit vs reissued invoice). Will ping once they reply.
Alex (Billing): :thumbsup: Good plan. Keep all evidence in the billing ticket so finance can act quickly.
Maria (CS): Thanks everyone — I'll mark as high priority until resolved.
